notes: Scoped redirects(target).from(request) and .to(request) reuse original snapshots in the existing 1000-hop connection-wide index. Observed links are authoritative; None requires terminal proof. RedirectUnknown distinguishes insufficient proof from RedirectUnavailable retention, ownership and lifetime errors. Effect.catchReason("RequestError", "RedirectUnknown", () => Effect.succeedNone) handles only uncertainty as no successor seen. Terminal redirect navigation proof uses the bounded page event log; an absent needed outcome in disabled or incomplete history remains an unavailable-evidence error; no tracking or implicit waiting is added.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: Redirect neighbor access reads the existing bounded hop index through a scoped page or context handle.

limitations: Scoped access, at most 1000 shared retained hops, exact original target-owned snapshots. Absent terminal navigation proof cannot establish a boundary; disabled or incomplete navigation history with no matching outcome remains an unavailable-evidence error.
Successor lookup preserves the observed canceled successor attempt for manual fetch; otherwise missing terminal proof is RedirectUnknown.
